description: This source file defines a factory function to create and configure a SessionServerAppManager object, which manages session server applications within the rialto server manager component. It includes dependencies on various factory classes and interfaces, and constructs the manager with specific parameters such as environment variables, paths, timeouts, and interval settings.

methods.name: createSessionServerAppManager
methods.description: Factory function that creates and returns a unique pointer to an ISessionServerAppManager, configured with dependencies and parameters such as IPC controller, state observer, environment variables, session server path, startup timeout, healthcheck interval, and socket permissions.
